correctness.rationale: The intersection of Q1=xy+z²+2u², Q2=4xu+yz+3uv+3v², Q3=x²+2y²+4z²+4uv in P4(F5) has exactly two rational points, 27 full-rank and four rank-four net quadrics, the latter all nonsplit (determinants 2,3,3,3). Independently enumerated all 31 rational net members and 781 rational projective points. Independently computed five affine-chart Jacobian-minor Gröbner ideals as unit ideals over F5, proving geometric smoothness. Adjunction gives genus5, complete intersection canonically embedded/nontrigonal. Faber–Grantham Lemma 6.6 makes absence of split rank4 or rank3 rational net members a gonality≥5 certificate, while K−3P at a rational point gives degree≤5 by Riemann–Roch; bound is over F5, not geometric.
residual_risks: Groebner certificates are exact for five charts; no independent formal algebra proof of the cited genus-five gonality lemma, which was read as published primary.
